verdict.rationale: Self-hosting a browser and scraping service via Docker is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows Browserbase's own hosted platform ("Deploy and run browser agents on Browserbase"), with no Docker image or self-hosted container deployment documented. A community thread framing an open-source project as the self-hosted alternative points the same way but is not first-party evidence.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy the scraping service via a Docker container for production use
